station_tags.rule: Station tag cart after every two songs unless a tag is already scheduled (a tag-like fixed element within 30 seconds).
station_tags.top_of_hour_rule: If the hour gets missed, play the station-id top-of-hour tag after the current song; if the song ends within 15 seconds of the hour, play the tag then the next song; the tag is never dropped. (Client-side catch-up; the rotation schedules the tag at :00 every hour.)

no_repeat.rule: No song, no take, and no shared-lyric set repeats within a full rotation cycle unless a request explicitly asked for it. Each cycle plays one take of every family in the pool, least-played take first, then starts a fresh cycle.

lyric_similarity.note: Only a handful of pool songs carry lyric text on file, so where lyrics are missing the essence-tag overlap is the proxy.

timing.rule: The walk advances by each song's real duration, and a song is never picked if it would overrun the next fixed element, so the printed guide matches the audio.

play_cap.rule: no song family more than the applied cap times a day (Ralph, 2026-11-23); no song, take, or shared-lyric set repeats within a rotation cycle (Ralph, 2026-11-25)
